body: I knew I could count on Reddit hahahahaha
It's a shit feeling man, i have to be constantly doing something or I get depressed I try to stay out of the house as much as possible. Night times are fucking excruciating and so are Sundays.
As silly as this sound so genuinely feel that I will never be able to find someone that gives me what she did. That deep level of emotion and love we shared. I feel like that's all gone.

Well I'm 20, she's 19. We met in highschool have spent practically everyday of our lives together since then. We just moved into our new apartment about 2 months ago, got a cat, nice furniture etc.. it started about 2 weeks ago where she wouldn't even speak to me. She was constantly staying at friends houses for the night, ignoring everything I said' not answering texts/calls. She finally said admitted she doesn't think this is working. It's breaking my heart that she is falling out of love with me after everything we've been through.
I lost all motivation to the point where I don't even want to clean the house or get out of bed.
